name: Slips Into Chinese (L25N42-)
effect: Answers the English prompts in Simplified Chinese, sometimes from the first word and sometimes switching partway through a sentence (e.g. 'Don't仅仅准备...', 'the oldest和最深奥的问题'). It doubles up terms with Chinese glosses and writes the sea poem
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs.
